info.text:
Apple just had a record quarter, and its stock still dropped.
Sales hit $114.5 billion from July to September, up 12% from a year ago.
But Apple expects its profit margin to slip from 47.9% to 45-46% this holiday quarter, citing an 'unprecedented' jump in memory chip costs driven by AI demand.
Shares were down about 4.7% before the opening bell Tuesday, Nov 3.
Sources: Apple earnings release (Nov 2, 2026), CNBC, Reuters.
News and education, not financial advice.
